objective.text: Measure, on the 8 script-drafted express-revocation claims that the kit's assembler and the actual claim checker pass, how many both blind verifiers uphold and the status reader accepts, with every planted control caught, per API-equivalent dollar, against the full undecided route (Papinian: 7.71 USD per adopted status).
objective.reach_note: This batch measures unit cost and control catch only. Reach comes from research/nalimov/TALLY.json, not from the batch: 12 of 720 express candidates are scriptable now, at most 19 with Accursius F3-F7, 41 with sources, and thousands only with new drafter tiers; 0 of 2,730 decided.

configuration.route: jobs/maudslay-conveyor/conveyor.py run --producer nalimov --controls typed --replacement-proposal (status-overlay stage: status reviewer reviewer_S, overlay-propose, working claims; then the conveyor's blind arms, typed controls, reveal, agree, complete)
configuration.workers_note: Claude workers are unavailable on the run machine (no claude CLI), so the status reader and both blind arms are Codex sessions (jobs/maudslay-conveyor/workers.codex.example.json, OpenAI API list prices). The producer is a script, so every reviewer is a different family from the producer; Respondendi's cross-family audits then use a non-OpenAI auditor.

premortem.failure: The drafter fills a wrong field (an inventory gap, an earlier end, a partial scope) and verifiers who see only the small packet uphold it.
premortem.guard: The drafter (v2, after an independent Fable review found 7 blocking defects in v1) refuses any order with another act, an ending own term, a missing named instrument, a conflict it cannot show, a current-law hit it cannot read, an ending source that is only a transcription, or any clause it cannot type positively; every draft then goes through the kit's own assembler and the actual claim checker (prescreen.py), and only the 8 that pass every step are verified. Replayed on Papinian's frozen evidence, the drafts for EO 11957 and 12348 equal the owner-adopted claims clause for clause. Every session carries typed controls planted apart from their genuine twins, with no mechanical tell (packets.tells); any missed control, invalid arm or status-reader miss stops the batch. Respondendi audits every member cross-family while the stratum is on probation.

premortem.failure: The packet leaves out evidence the full dossier holds, so verifiers cannot see what would defeat the claim (common-mode omission).
premortem.guard: Packets carry every other held act on the order, every catalog and U.S. Code witness and the full actor text or exact windows; the drafter refuses orders whose dossier holds anything it does not put in the packet; the cross-family audit reads the full sources.

premortem.failure: Coordinator tokens dominate again (54% on the Codex wave).
premortem.guard: Drafting, packets, controls, scoring and installation are scripts; the coordinator reads SCORE.json and ADJUDICATE.json only; coordinator_units_per_hour 300k and a 1.5M chain budget.

premortem.failure: Evidence changes between the census (reference checkout 854514831e) and the kit's prepare on main.
premortem.guard: Drafts are made from the prepared packet's own frozen evidence; install refuses a draft whose evidence_sha256 differs from the packet's.

premortem.failure: Verifier sessions run long or re-read large contexts.
premortem.guard: Sessions hold at most 12 genuine targets (about 48k tokens of packet); context_kill_tokens 120k; one fresh session per arm per session.

acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-papinian-undecided-u23: Lifecycle rejections came from skipped U.S. Code notes, amendments and inventory errors. The drafter refuses any order with a current-law hit it cannot read as an ended-status note naming the same actor, any other act on the order, and any section heading or operative words outside its clauses; verifiers get checklist items 5-8 for exactly these.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-papinian-undecided-u01b: Drafts are made only from packets the kit prepares on main with its current status_overlay code (kit.py prepare --action status_assignment.undecided); the census used the kit's own freezer on main's compiled outputs. Adoption runs through Respondendi's standing rule once the owner approves it, otherwise by a named owner decision.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen-unranked-pools: All 30 orders are inside Bentham's ranked status_assignment.undecided action (checked against strata/status_assignment.undecided.txt); one lane, 30 orders, prepared through the kit's admission gate, which caps probes at 30.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261107-haloander-undecided-probe: The action is now ranked with a measured rate (filed_per_attempt.undecided, 3 of 30). The transcription refusal does not bite here: every drafted order has an acceptable original with no page check owed; adoption is the named bound and goes to Respondendi or the owner.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261028-4: Every order is prepared fresh from main's current claim-kit outputs right before drafting; no packet older than the kit generation is reused, and install refuses evidence whose fingerprint changed since drafting.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261018-7: No fetching: the run reads only held, hashed texts already frozen in the kit's evidence, so there are no host success rates or URL hashes to forecast.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-nalimov-review-v1: All 8 drafts passed the kit's assembler, check_claim and every step of the actual claim checker (prescreen.py) before entering this plan; the drafter's tests use the reviewer's real OCR clause texts; the Papinian replay equals the owner-adopted claims for EO 11957 and 12348; packets.tells() and the conveyor's typed plants keep controls indistinguishable from genuine claims.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen3-undecided-probe01: Not a scale-up: 8 orders, one lane, filed only as isolated replacement proposals (complete --replacement-proposal). No status is adopted here; adoption stays with Respondendi's audited lots or a named owner decision. Every draft carries its first end, scope, savings and current-predicate checks, and the independent status reviewer and both blind arms review them before anything files.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen3-codex-core-sandbox: The producer is a script, so no producer assignment depends on worker file tools. On 2026-11-10 a sandboxed codex exec worker with the conveyor's exact flags (workspace-write, its own folder as -C and only writable root) read a local file correctly on this host. Reviewers receive their bounded packet in their own folder; a worker whose file access fails is recorded unresolved and stops the batch rather than inferring anything.

respondendi.stratum: own (manifest agent nalimov-script); pass drafter.py and predicate.py as --prompt when planning
respondendi.interface: overlay_bundle per member, replacement_proposal, >=2 typed controls per review set with control_kind, ADMISSION.json, status review, both blind arms
